Resolves #18694

`PreviewLanguageDragPairNL` held the last four `toHaveScreenshot` calls in `test/playwright/e2e`, compared against goldens no CI workflow re-mints, with a call-site `maxDiffPixels: 150` and no declared mode. Each parked scene is now read as values and compared with scenes read earlier in the same run. Every affordance parks in the same place in all four scenes. The signal language repaints the zone preview, the indicator menu and the drag proxy, and the light theme repaints all three, the body-mounted proxy included. The four goldens are removed.

The first run of those assertions found a defect the goldens had carried: **the Signal language's drag-proxy ring never painted.** `body > .neo-dock-dragproxy.neo-tab-header-toolbar` grounds every dock drag proxy at specificity (0,2,1). It outranks the sibling `.neo-dock-dragproxy.neo-preview-lang-signal` at (0,2,0), so its single shadow replaced the ring. The ring is now nested under the ground rule.

Evidence: L3 (the Neural Link journey, run headless and headed on this checkout, red-first for the ring, plus three seeded controls) → L3 required, because no CI workflow selects this Brain-gated spec. Residual: none.

## Deltas from ticket

- **Route 1, and no mode contract.** Everything the Signal treatment changes is readable as geometry and computed paint, so these arms needed no pixel exception.
- **An engine stylesheet fix ships with a test ticket.** The proxy ring is the treatment these arms exist to protect. Shipping the arm without the fix meant either a red spec or an assertion that excuses the proxy.
- **`parkTheDrag` settles on a condition instead of 600ms.** In one of two headed runs, the first version read the indicator cross 635px from the park point; the pixel arms carried the same race. The drag now counts as parked once the center indicator has hover-locked inside the accepted preview covering the park point, with no affordance animating. A first attempt that waited for position alone read the scene before the lock landed, and the reduced-motion arm caught it.
- **`unit/dashboard/DockPreview.spec.mjs` follows the nesting.** Its stylesheet census asserted the ring's sibling selector text, which the fix removes. It now pins the nesting itself, and against dev's sibling rule it fails at that assertion (1 failed, 70 passed).
- **The frozen clock and the `NEO_TEST_SKIP_CI` skip are removed.** Both existed only for the goldens; the skip's reason read "rendered-platform goldens". CI never selects this spec: it is Brain-gated, and `e2eCiSelection` deselects it.
